entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 13599 of 2023

Applicant :- Sanjay Verma @ Sanjay Kumar Verma
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Sukh Deo Singh,Paritosh Shukla Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1. Heard Sri Sukh Deo Singh, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Virendra Kumar,
the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
126 of 2023, under Section 409, 420 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Vibhuti Khand, District Lucknow.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 11.03.2023 against the applicant and one Deepak Singh, describing the applicant as M.D of Aviance Developers Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. and the co-accused as its C.M.D., stating that the informant had entered into an agreement dated 05.02.2016 for purchasing a plot from the aforesaid company and had paid Rs.2,74,208/- in installments but neither the land was transferred to the informant nor was his money refunded.
Sanjay Verma @ Sanjay Kumar Verma vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Sanjay Verma @ Sanjay Kumar Verma vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, the applicant's involvement in ten other cases has been disclosed in paras 18 and 19, in three of which the applicant has been granted bail.
5. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that from the averments made in the F.I.R itself prima facie it appears that an agreement for purchase of immovable property was entered on 05.02.2016, which agreement was not registered;
the informant has not initiated any proceedings for transfer of the land or recovery of money and the F.I.R appears to have been lodged to pressurize the applicant to redress the informant's grievance without the later taking recourse to any civil proceedings, coupled with the fact that the applicant is languishing in jail since 22.07.2023 and without making any observations which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 18.11.2023 Ram.
 
Sanjay Verma @ Sanjay Kumar Verma vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
